sources.method: Exploratory internal retrieval: all proposal titles were fetched from the public open-city-ai/haidian submissions catalog (GitHub API, pulls+issues titles, state=all, per_page=100, pages 1-11; 1,100 titles total on 2026-08-29). Search terms: 硅碳/碳硅/硅之城/之城/SILICON-CARBON/carbon-silicon (case-insensitive substring). Exact-match hits: 0 for the main name and English variants; 1 word-family hit ('落朵智能体之城'). Normalization: no diacritics or hyphenation normalization was applied beyond case folding.
